posts.text: As the Trump administration continues its blockade of Iranian ports and Iran limits passage through the Strait of Hormuz, prices for fuel and fertilizer continue to soar above prewar levels. ampr.gs/4dhS8EA

Americans that drive electric vehicles can reduce their costs and avoid the dramatic changes in price at the pump, yet some members of Congress are pursing policies that would make EVs more expensive. ampr.gs/4nr8hfK

Trade-offs between gas money, energy bills, and groceries are impossible ones to make. Yet the Trump administration continues to make choices that make the impossible an everyday reality for too many families.

The full cost of Trump's war in Iran will not be measured only by the destruction in the Middle East or the disruption of global trade, but by the knock-on effects of the Trump administration’s actions, which are playing out across Africa and elsewhere. ampr.gs/4tNvc6I

New CAP analysis finds that the difference between what rural households pay for gas compared with urban households has increased from $10 to $16 per week, or $46 to $70 on a monthly basis. ampr.gs/4dhS8EA

From the Qatari private jet to exclusive private dinners for crypto investors, Trump's "pay-to-play" deals appear to be nothing more than self-enrichment, plain and simple. americanprogress.org/article…

President Trump’s war of choice in Iran has triggered a global energy and fertilizer crisis, disproportionately devastating African countries already strained by debt and climate stress. ampr.gs/4tNvc6I
Trump's war in Iran is raising costs for rural communities and farmers, with rural households paying, on average, at least $26 per week more at the pump. ampr.gs/4dhS8EA

Hawaii is officially the FIRST IN THE NATION to effectively undo #CitizensUnited. Corporations will no longer have the power to spend in the state's politics. 

Learn more about the historic legislation: ampr.gs/3QEambX

CAP's @thmoore: “Hawaii is taking a brave and bold step to get corporate and dark money out of America’s politics. It will send a powerful message that will be heard loud and clear across the Pacific and across the mainland." bit.ly/4udwNDA

Does Hawaii's S.B. 2471 violate the Supreme Court's Citizens United decision? No. The first-in-the-nation bill does not regulate a corporation's power to spend in politics—rather, it no longer grants it. 

More FAQs about S.B. 2471 ⬇️ ampr.gs/3QEambX
All eyes are on Gov. Green (D) after a nearly unanimous and bipartisan majority in Hawaii's state legislature voted to get dark and corporate money out of its politics. theatlantic.com/politics/202…

Under the surface of the Trump administration's pro-crypto policies is a self-enrichment scheme that has seen Trump and his family profit handsomely, including from deals with foreign nations. ampr.gs/42uGykJ

“We do not serve artificial entities. We serve the people.” @SenatorJarrett on Hawaii making history by getting dark and corporate money out of politics. #CitizensUnited
